data.name: Lines We Draw
data.detailed_description:
Lines We Draw is a single-player 3D isometric indie narrative strategy game about duty, empathy, and survival at a Cold War border checkpoint.

As a border inspector between two rival socialist states, you decide who may cross and who must stay behind.
Every document tells a story, and every stamp you press draws a line between loyalty and humanity.

After years of brutal conflict, an uneasy calm has settled between Krasnograd and Holosztazska.
The borders are reopening, but distrust lingers on both sides.

Each day, travelers arrive, families seeking safety, smugglers with contraband, deserters, spies, and ordinary workers caught in the crossfire of politics and survival.

Your duty is to inspect their papers, verify their stories, and make a choice - approve or deny.
Your decisions will shape lives, determine fates, and decide whether peace endures or collapses.

Receive documents and examine every detail, names, dates, stamps, photos, permits.
Ask questions. Request missing papers. Compare stories and faces.

Then make your judgment - do they pass… or stay behind the wire?

Each day brings new orders, new rules, and growing pressure from superiors who measure your accuracy and loyalty.
But ordinary people will remember your mercy or cruelty.

Rules and regulations change day by day. Political pressure mounts, and the atmosphere at the checkpoint grows tense.
What begins as routine work quickly turns into a moral crossroads - where the fate of individuals, and the balance between nations, rests on your judgment.

Your choices have lasting consequences. You may rise as a hero of the people, become a loyal instrument of the regime, or remain lost in the gray zone between both worlds.
At the border, there are no easy decisions.

• Daily border shifts – Check passports, visas, and belongings under increasing pressure.

• Moral dilemmas – Obey the regime or follow your conscience. Every decision matters.

• Shifting politics – Each day brings new rules, restrictions, and unexpected events.

• Dynamic encounters – Refugees, spies, smugglers, soldiers, and desperate families - each with unique stories and consequences.

• Dynamic environment and weather – Each day looks a little different. The political situation changes, and so do the shapes of the borders.

• Branching outcomes – Become a hero of the people, a loyal instrument of the regime, or remain lost in the gray zone between.

• Replay value – Treat people differently and experience new endings to the story.

• Distinctive style – A semi-realistic visual look inspired by socialist propaganda art and Cold War-era paintings.

At the border, truth is never black and white.

Every decision leaves a mark - on others, and on You.

data.short_description: Lines We Draw is a 3D isometric narrative strategy game set at a tense Cold War border. Inspect documents, interrogate travelers, and manage a shifting checkpoint between rival states. Your stamp decides fates: Will you be a hero of the people, or a tool of the regime?

pc_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • 운영 체제: Windows 10
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • 메모리: 8000 MB RAM
  • 그래픽: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4 GB / GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB / AMD Radeon RX 560 4 GB or equivalent
  • 저장 공간: 10 GB 사용 가능 공간
  • 사운드카드: DirectX compatible
  • 추가 사항: DIRECTX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • 운영 체제: Windows 10/11
  • 프로세서: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X / Intel Core i7-8700 or better
  • 메모리: 8000 MB RAM
  • 그래픽: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB or better
  • 저장 공간: 10 GB 사용 가능 공간
  • 사운드카드: DirectX compatible
  • 추가 사항: DIRECTX: Version 11

linux_requirements.minimum:
최소:
  • 운영 체제: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS
  • 프로세서: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • 메모리: 8000 MB RAM
  • 그래픽: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4 GB / AMD Radeon equivalent (Vulkan support required)
  • 저장 공간: 10 GB 사용 가능 공간
  • 사운드카드: Standard audio device
  • 추가 사항: Vulkan API required. Fully supported on Steam Deck.
linux_requirements.recommended:

  • 운영 체제: SteamOS 3.0 (Steam Deck) or newer
  • 프로세서: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X / Intel Core i7-8700 or better
  • 메모리: 8000 MB RAM
  • 그래픽: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • 저장 공간: 10 GB 사용 가능 공간
  • 사운드카드: Standard audio device
  • 추가 사항: Optimized for Steam Deck.
